svg.title: AC9E1LA01 — I can use words, facial expressions and gestures to communicate clearly and choose useful open or closed questions.
svg.desc: Notice how words, facial expressions, gestures and body language change a message. Recognise that First Nations Australian communication can include important symbols, gestures and body language. Use words and body language to show emotions. Tell the difference between a closed question and an open question.
